discovery_notes: Cell B067 licensed exclusion review (2015-2026). 25 standard searches, snippets only. Re-checked items left out of 206/208/214/215/216. Recorded: 2019 BoxLunch/Hot Topic pins not in 208 (Pooh, Mickey Rainbow Heads, Meg, Belle Castle, WALL-E & EVE, EVE Earth Day, Princess Bows mystery, Sleeping Beauty set, No Touchy, Captain Marvel); JCPenney Mickey 90 sets (set level); Handbag pin pack (parks OE, wdw+dlr set level); Holiday Nutcrackers (dsus OE, 8 pins); HK Times Square Incredibles 2 (lic, 5 pins); ArtLand LE 250 villains + Pooh; Funko Endgame BoxLunch mystery + Avengers Attributes. Princess and Lilo & Stitch mystery buttons (216) confirmed ~1in buttons -> excluded. Princess Bows full lineup from Disney Pin Forum only. Resellers (collectrandom, jd-collectibles, yourwdwstore, letsgopintrading, distradingpins4u) not used.
